note: A1+ Unit 1 Lesson 1.12 built on 2026-11-18 as the unit review, the follow-up of A1 1.12 Unit 1 Story Review under the user's 2026-11-09 same-number rule and the 2026-11-18 renumbering (A1+ 1.12 <- review); the user asked for Unit 1 to be completed straight to Preview. As the A1+ standards ask, the review uses fresh people and photographs and no new language: one new family (the grandparents, a tall father, a mother with long hair, a daughter, a son and their dog Toby) in eight new Flash photos (v01-v08), and every unit function returns: descriptions (1.1), he/she -s (1.2), they without -s (1.3), live with (1.4), older/younger (1.5), frequency (1.6), How often and -ies (1.7), don't/doesn't (1.8), Does...?, Where does...?, Who does...? and short answers (1.9), its (1.10) and him/her/them (1.11). Nobody in the family speaks in the first person (the cast's voices belong to the cast), so the teacher asks and the co-teacher answers. Coffee and tea cannot be told apart in v01 (both cups read as tea), so no line says that the grandparents drink coffee.

lesson.title: 1.12 Review: a new family
lesson.unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people’s habits.
lesson.goal: Describe a new family and say what each person does and how often, ask about them with does, and answer with short answers, its and him/her/them, with no new language.
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 1.12 Unit 1 Story Review: A1 reviews Unit 1 with fresh scenes; A1+ 1.12 reviews every A1+ Unit 1 function with one fresh family and no new language: descriptions, the he/she -s, they, older and younger, frequency words, How often, don't and doesn't, Does...? with short answers, Where does and Who does, its, and him, her and them.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Retell what each family member does with the right verb form (he works / they swim / she doesn't), ask with does, and keep him, her and them at the end. Do not require native-like speed.
